plain_text:
Page 11 is the Submission page and contains a list of any unresolved Errors and Warnings for
each page within the APR (see fig. 26). Select the related page link to navigate to the page that
contains the error or warning. There are rules that apply to related data elements that span
across multiple pages. For those pages, the rule will be displayed on the first page with the
relevant data element. Scroll to the bottom of Page 11 to download all errors and warnings as
an Excel file.
